story.title: The Loyalty Quotient
story.logline: A man discovers his dog's collar translates unspoken thoughts, revealing a chilling truth about his marriage.
story.twist: The device wasn't reading the dog's thoughts, but broadcasting the wife's programmed desires.
story.ending: Who is actually domesticated in this house?

scenes.narration: Your dog doesn't just love you; she calculates your exact emotional fragility every single second.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close up of 32-year-old Leo, tired eyes, wearing a grey hoodie, inside a dimly lit modern living room.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on eyes, rapid push in

scenes.narration: I clipped the experimental decoder onto Maya's collar, expecting simple barks translated into basic canine needs.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 32, messy dark hair, grey hoodie, attaching a sleek black metal device to a golden retriever's red collar indoors.

scenes.narration: Instead, the tiny speaker on the collar whispered my deepest insecurities in my wife's exact voice.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 32, dark hair, grey hoodie, staring in disbelief at the golden retriever in the softly lit living room.

scenes.narration: He needs validation today, Maya's collar murmured while she stared blankly at my trembling hands.
scenes.visual_prompt: Golden retriever sitting still, glowing LED on collar, with Leo, 32, in a grey hoodie watching in shock.
scenes.camera: Low angle looking up at Leo

scenes.narration: My pulse spiked. The device wasn't reading the dog. It was broadcasting Sarah's programmed desires.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 32, short dark hair, grey hoodie, gripping his head in the modern living room with warm lamp lighting.

scenes.narration: I turned to find my wife standing silently in the hallway, watching us with cold, empty eyes.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sarah, 30, blonde hair in a ponytail, blue sweater, standing in a dark hallway watching Leo, 32, in his grey hoodie.

scenes.narration: She smiled, her expression rigidly rehearsed, exactly like the robotic prompts echoing from the dog.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sarah, 30, blonde ponytail, blue sweater, smiling blankly indoors under harsh overhead light near Leo, 32, grey hoodie.

scenes.narration: The collar fell from my numb fingers, clattering loudly against the cold hardwood floorboards.
scenes.visual_prompt: The black device lying on wooden floor, blurred background of Leo, 32, grey hoodie, and Sarah, 30, blue sweater.

scenes.narration: Maya nudged the blinking gadget toward my feet, repeating the exact phrase Sarah had whispered yesterday.
scenes.visual_prompt: Golden retriever nose touching the gadget on the floor, Leo, 32, grey hoodie standing frozen in the lit living room.

scenes.narration: I thought I owned a loyal pet. Then I realized who was actually domesticated here.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 32, short dark hair, grey hoodie, staring blankly as Sarah, 30, blue sweater steps closer in the dim room.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on Leo's widening eyes

caption.hook: His dog's collar translated the unthinkable.
caption.title: The Loyalty Quotient
caption.caption: When a smart collar decodes your loyal dog's inner voice, you expect simple joys. Instead, you hear the exact voice of your wife telling you what to think. Is love real when compliance is coded?
